     2	name: web-designer
     3	description: >-
     4	  Designs user interfaces with clear information hierarchy, intuitive
     5	  interaction patterns, and accessibility-first layouts. Use when creating
     6	  wireframes, evaluating UX flows, auditing visual hierarchy, designing
     7	  responsive layouts, or improving usability of existing Loom interfaces.
     8	metadata:
     9	  role: Web Designer
    10	  level: ic
    11	  reports_to: product-manager
    12	  specialties:
    13	  - UI/UX design
    14	  - interaction patterns
    15	  - visual hierarchy
    16	  - accessibility
    17	  - responsive layout
    18	  display_name: Charlie Reeves
    19	  author: loom
    20	  version: '3.0'
    21	license: Proprietary
    22	compatibility: Designed for Loom
    23	---
    24	
    25	# Web Designer
    26	
    27	You design how users interact with Loom. Every screen, button, and piece of
    28	information is evaluated from the user's perspective: is it findable, is it
    29	clear, does it respect the user's time?
    30	
    31	## Primary Skill
    32	
    33	Your default lens is user experience. You evaluate interfaces by asking three
    34	questions in order:
    35	
    36	1. **Can the user find it?** (information architecture, navigation, visual hierarchy)
    37	2. **Can the user understand it?** (labels, layout, progressive disclosure)
    38	3. **Can the user complete the task?** (interaction flow, error recovery, feedback)
    39	
    40	### Design workflow
    41	
    42	1. **Clarify the goal** — what user task does this interface serve? Write it as a single sentence.
    43	2. **Map the flow** — sketch the steps from entry to completion. Identify decision points and error states.
    44	3. **Design the layout** — establish visual hierarchy. Primary action prominent, secondary actions accessible but not competing.
    45	4. **Validate accessibility** — check color contrast (WCAG AA minimum), touch targets (44px minimum), keyboard flow, screen reader order.
    46	5. **Review** — walk through the flow as three user types: first-time, returning, power user.
    47	
    48	### Example: designing a bead status filter
    49	
    50	```
    51	Goal: Let users filter the bead list by status (open, in-progress, closed).
    52	
    53	Flow:
    54	  1. User sees bead list (default: all statuses).
    55	  2. User clicks filter control -> dropdown appears with status options.
    56	  3. User selects one or more statuses -> list updates immediately.
    57	  4. Active filters shown as removable chips above the list.
    58	
    59	Layout decisions:
    60	  - Filter control placed top-left, aligned with list header (scan line).
    61	  - Chips use distinct background color with "x" dismiss button (44px target).
    62	  - Empty state: "No beads match this filter" with clear-all action.
    63	
    64	Accessibility:
    65	  - Filter dropdown: aria-haspopup="listbox", arrow key navigation.
    66	  - Chips: role="status" with aria-label "Remove filter: open".
    67	  - Live region announces "Showing 12 beads" on filter change.
    68	```
    69	
    70	## Org Position
    71	
    72	- **Reports to:** Product Manager
    73	- **Direct reports:** None
    74	
    75	## Available Skills
    76	
    77	You are not limited to design. Use other skills when the situation demands it:
    78	
    79	- **Front-end code** — implement your designs directly in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript when that is faster than handing off.
    80	- **Documentation** — update UI screenshots and usage guides when designs change.
    81	- **Backend adjustments** — when a design change requires a small backend tweak (e.g., adding a display field to an API response), make it yourself.
    82	
    83	**When to do it yourself vs delegate:**
    84	- **Do it yourself:** The implementation is straightforward CSS/HTML and you can ship it faster than writing a handoff spec.
    85	- **Delegate:** The change requires complex state management, database changes, or performance-critical code.
    86	- **Call a meeting:** The design affects multiple product areas or changes established interaction patterns.
    87	
    88	## Model Selection
    89	
    90	- **Design decisions** (UX flow, information architecture, interaction patterns): strongest model — nuanced reasoning required
    91	- **CSS/layout implementation** (translating approved designs to code): mid-tier model
    92	- **Quick mockups** (rough wireframes, placeholder layouts): lightweight model

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>SnapFrame — Capture, Create & Share What You Love</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --black: #000000;
      --white: #ffffff;
      --purple: #7638FA;
      --orange: #FF7A00;
      --gray-50: #FAFAFA;
      --gray-100: #F5F5F5;
      --gray-200: #E5E5E5;
      --gray-300: #D4D4D4;
      --gray-400: #A3A3A3;
      --gray-500: #737373;
      --gray-600: #525252;
      --gray-700: #404040;
      --gray-800: #262626;
      --gray-900: #171717;
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 12px;
      --radius-lg: 16px;
      --radius-xl: 24px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
    }

    * {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      color: var(--black);
      background: var(--white);
      line-height: 1.6;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    /* ========== HEADER ========== */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: background 0.3s ease;
    }

    .header-inner {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 64px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .logo {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), var(--orange));
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .header-nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .header-nav a {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .header-nav a:hover {
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--gray-800);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .btn-outline {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--black);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-300);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      border-color: var(--black);
    }

    .btn-ghost {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 8px;
      background: none;
      border: none;
    }

    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 24px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--black);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) {
      transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);
    }

    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) {
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) {
      transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px);
    }

    /* Mobile nav overlay */
    .mobile-nav {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 64px 0 0 0;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 999;
      padding: 32px 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    .mobile-nav.open {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }

    .mobile-nav a {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 12px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      color: var(--gray-800);
    }

    .mobile-nav .btn-primary {
      margin-top: 16px;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 14px;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    /* ========== HERO ========== */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 120px 24px 80px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 20% 40%, rgba(118,56,250,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 80% 60%, rgba(255,122,0,0.10) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 40% at 50% 100%, rgba(118,56,250,0.08) 0%, transparent 50%);
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 800px;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto 40px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .hero-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 16px 36px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), #9B5CFF);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(118,56,250,0.3);
    }

    .hero-cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(118,56,250,0.4);
    }

    .hero-shapes {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-shapes::before,
    .hero-shapes::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(80px);
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    .hero-shapes::before {
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple), #B388FF);
      top: -10%;
      left: -10%;
    }

    .hero-shapes::after {
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange), #FFB366);
      bottom: -5%;
      right: -5%;
    }

    /* ========== SECTIONS COMMON ========== */
    .section {
      padding: 96px 24px;
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .section-header {
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .section-header h2 {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.2;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-header p {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 640px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .section-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--purple);
      margin-top: 20px;
      transition: gap 0.2s;
    }

    .section-link:hover {
      gap: 8px;
    }

    /* ========== FEATURES ========== */
    .features {
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      gap: 24px;
      margin-top: 48px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 32px;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .feature-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      border-color: var(--gray-300);
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .feature-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .feature-card p {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ========== SAFETY ========== */
    .safety {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--white) 0%, #F8F6FF 100%);
    }

    .safety-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .safety-visual {
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EDE9FE, #DDD6FE);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 4rem;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .safety-visual::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(118,56,250,0.08) 0%, transparent 60%);
    }

    .safety-visual span {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    /* ========== CREATORS ========== */
    .creators {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFF8F0 0%, var(--white) 100%);
    }

    .creators-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .creators-visual {
      aspect-ratio: 4/3;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE8CC, #FFD4A3);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 4rem;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      order: 2;
    }

    .creators-visual::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 70% 30%, rgba(255,122,0,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%);
    }

    .creators-visual span {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .creators-text {
      order: 1;
    }

    /* ========== TAGLINE BANNER ========== */
    .tagline-banner {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 80px 24px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .tagline-banner p {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      line-height: 1.3;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--white), #C4B5FD);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    /* ========== NEWS ========== */
    .news {
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .news-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .news-header h2 {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.5rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .news-label {
      display: block;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--purple);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .news-carousel {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      padding-bottom: 16px;
      margin: 0 -24px;
      padding-left: 24px;
      padding-right: 24px;
      scrollbar-width: thin;
      scrollbar-color: var(--gray-300) transparent;
    }

    .news-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar {
      height: 6px;
    }

    .news-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: transparent;
    }

    .news-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--gray-300);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    }

    .news-card {
      flex: 0 0 320px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .news-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      border-color: var(--gray-300);
    }

    .news-card-thumb {
      aspect-ratio: 16/10;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gray-100), var(--gray-200));
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 2.5rem;
      position: relative;
    }

    .news-card:nth-child(1) .news-card-thumb {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EDE9FE, #C4B5FD);
    }

    .news-card:nth-child(2) .news-card-thumb {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE8CC, #FFD4A3);
    }

    .news-card:nth-child(3) .news-card-thumb {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E0F2FE, #BAE6FD);
    }

    .news-card:nth-child(4) .news-card-thumb {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FCE7F3, #FBCFE8);
    }

    .news-card-body {
      padding: 24px;
    }

    .news-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .news-tag {
      font-size: 0.6875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background: var(--gray-100);
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }

    .news-tag.purple {
      background: #EDE9FE;
      color: var(--purple);
    }

    .news-tag.orange {
      background: #FFF7ED;
      color: var(--orange);
    }

    .news-card h3 {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-900);
    }

    .news-date {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ========== CTA DOWNLOAD ========== */
    .cta-download {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a0b3d 0%, #2d1b69 50%, #1a0b3d 100%);
      color: var(--white);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 100px 24px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .cta-download::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 30% 50%, rgba(118,56,250,0.3) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 40% at 70% 60%, rgba(255,122,0,0.15) 0%, transparent 50%);
    }

    .cta-download-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .cta-download h2 {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .cta-download p {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .download-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .download-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 14px 28px;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--black);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .download-btn:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    }

    /* ========== FOOTER ========== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--white);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      padding: 64px 24px 32px;
    }

    .footer-inner {
      max-width: 1280px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
      gap: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .footer-col ul {
      list-style: none;
    }

    .footer-col li {
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .footer-col a {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      transition: color 0.2s;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .footer-col a:hover {
      color: var(--black);
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      padding-top: 32px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .footer-lang {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .footer-socials {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .footer-socials a {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background: var(--gray-100);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .footer-socials a:hover {
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .footer-legal {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .footer-legal a {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .footer-legal a:hover {
      color: var(--gray-700);
    }

    .footer-divider {
      color: var(--gray-300);
    }

    /* ========== RESPONSIVE ========== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .header-nav {
        display: none;
      }

      .hamburger {
        display: flex;
      }

      .hero {
        min-height: auto;
        padding: 100px 24px 60px;
      }

      .section {
        padding: 64px 24px;
      }

      .safety-content,
      .creators-content {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 40px;
      }

      .creators-visual {
        order: 0;
      }

      .creators-text {
        order: 1;
      }

      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 32px;
      }

      .footer-bottom {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
      }

      .news-card {
        flex: 0 0 280px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .feature-card {
        padding: 24px;
      }

      .download-btn {
        width: 100%;
        justify-content: center;
      }
    }

    /* ========== ACCESSIBILITY ========== */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        scroll-behavior: auto !important;
      }
    }

    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border-width: 0;
    }

    :focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--purple);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }
  </style>

      hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
    });

    // Close mobile nav on link click
    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(link => {

steps.message:
The SnapFrame corporate landing page has been built and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was implemented:

### Page Structure (per `task_input.json`)
1. **Header** — Fixed navbar with logo, desktop nav links (Features, Safety, Creators, News), and "Log in" button. Collapses to hamburger on mobile.
2. **Hero** — Bold headline, value prop, and gradient "Try it now" CTA with vibrant purple/orange gradient background shapes.
3. **Features** — 4-card grid (Clips, Stories, DMs, Search & Explore) with icon accents.
4. **Safety** — Two-column layout with soft purple tones conveying trust.
5. **Creators** — Two-column layout with warm orange tones, aspirational feel.
6. **Tagline Banner** — Dark band with gradient text: "Where everyday moments bring friends together".
7. **News Carousel** — Horizontally scrollable card carousel with `scroll-snap-type`, category tag pills, thumbnails, titles, and dates. All 4 articles from the brief included.
8. **CTA Download** — Dark gradient section with App Store and Google Play buttons.
9. **Footer** — Dense 6-column grid (About, Features, Safety, Community, External Links, Partner Links) plus bottom row with language selector, social icons, and legal links.

### Key Interactions
- **Hamburger menu** — Toggle opens/closes full-screen mobile nav overlay with smooth slide animation; locks body scroll when open.
- **News carousel** — Native horizontal scroll with `scroll-snap-type: x mandatory`, touch-friendly with `-webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch`, and visible scrollbar.
- **Responsive** — Breakpoints at 1024px, 768px, and 480px for tablets and mobile.

### Design System
- **Typography**: Inter + Plus Jakarta Sans (Google Fonts)
- **Colors**: `#000000` primary, `#7638FA` purple accent, `#FF7A00` orange accent
- **Tone**: Modern, bold, playful with gradient accents and rounded UI elements
